title: Comunidad Andina
goal: Read how Chile (1976) and later Venezuela left the Andean bloc por su cuenta, alongside the NAFTA treaty negotiated by Salinas de Gortari and its uneven impact on Mexican regions.

items: Describe what the NAFTA treaty meant for the Mexican economy.
Explain that Chile withdrew from the bloc in 1976 acting on its own.
Explain that Venezuela later also chose to act on its own.
Describe how NAFTA's social impact differed between regions such as Monterrey and Oaxaca.
Use por su cuenta to describe acting independently.
